correctness.rationale: The rank-r witness has exactly r quantifiers, and the class-matching Ehrenfeucht–Fraïssé strategy succeeds with r-1 singletons plus r copies of all sizes 2 through r. Exact block marking gives the coefficient identity. For fixed j,t, saddle concentration of exp(e^z-1) with the fixed polynomial marking perturbation gives local left-tail asymptotics, negligible j>=2 deficits, and the matching leading constant. checker.py reproduces exact Bell and singleton counts through n=8, and precise left-tail approximations at n=80,160,320; none of the finite checks is substituted for the proof.

value.rationale: Determining a single precise failure rate for the entire bounded-rank first-order theory under canonical uniform set-partition sampling is a motivated quantitative logical limit law. The sharp rate identifies exactly which finite structure feature dominates all other errors, as opposed to merely recomputing Bell or singleton enumeration tables. It provides a fixed-rank calibration for finite-model approximations.
